name: Marshall JH-1 Jackhammer
description: Marshall JH-1 Jackhammer (1998) as drawn on Marshall's 'JH-1 MAIN UNIT DIAGRAM', Rev 2, 24.6.98 (MU.S01): single 9 V supply, REF = R7/R6 47K halves with C7 100 uF. IC1:A TL072 non-inverting stage with the GAIN pot's wiper on its output (feedback leg R10 2.2K + C8 to the J176 effect switch, on) -> the far end of the same pot feeds IC1:B (680K // 47 pF over R14 + R27 4.7K) -> R12 1K into the clipper: a pair of red LEDs always across node B, plus the 1N4148 pair (D CLIP) on SW2:A -> passive bass/treble stack (R2 6.8K, C3 22n, C2 220n, C1 22n, R8 1K, TREBLE B20K, BASS A100K rheostat) -> IC2:A make-up (x6.6, or x1.7 with SW2:B's C27/R30 leg in L CLIP) -> the CONTOUR section: IC3:B (x1.47) drives a Wien bridge (2 x 15 nF, the FREQ dual C100K plus 2.2K each) into IC3:A's + input while IC3:A inverts the dry signal through R9/R17 100K; CONTOUR mixes dry and IC3:A's output into IC3:B -> R25/R26 halving -> IC2:B multiple-feedback filter (R19 8.2K, C16 47n, C17 68n, R22 10K // C24 2n2, R20 100K, R23 47K, R24 1M // C23 47p) -> VOLUME B100K -> R29 10K / R31 47K -> C18 150n -> output (R16 1M). The footswitch (SW1) is the host bypass; the netlist is the effect position. Single factory source.

sources.title: Marshall Amplification, 'JH-1 MAIN UNIT DIAGRAM', Rev 2, 24.6.98, drawn by Surajit, filename MU.S01 (A2 vector CAD drawing, main / jack / control PCBs; print header 'Printed: 20 Feb 2001 10:53 v:\pedals\jh1.dia'). Archived copy (the live diystompboxes URL returns 403). Single source: the only other copy found (Scribd 587733953) is a printout of the same file

lte.note: LTE substeps start on BDF2 (docs §10.61). Engine 8x fine-step truth, audio band, lead / rock DI: 0.190 / 0.419 % -> 0.173 / 0.344 %; aliasing gate at 0.5 FS -31.6 -> -35.4 dB (every bin). CPU equal (9900X)

multirate.note: Base 192 kHz; the IC1A / IC1B gain stages (VR1B) at 384 kHz and the LED / 1N4148 clipper group (C12) at 768 kHz (docs §10.62). At a 96 kHz base with C12 at 384 kHz the op-amp stages fold at -35.9 / -35.4 / -27.1 dB (aliasing gate, every bin, 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0 FS); now -76.5 / -63.3 / -73.3 dB (C12 at 1.536 MHz: -78.7 / -76.3 / -76.3 dB, for +23 % CPU). A 192 kHz base, not more ladder levels: every half-band converter pair on the signal path costs truth through its phase (VR1B 8 and C12 32 on the 96 kHz base: 0.216 / 0.453 %). Engine 8x fine-step truth (band-limited), audio band, lead / rock DI: 0.172 / 0.344 -> 0.073 / 0.117 %

TL072_9V.note: TI TL072 (drawing: TL072 on IC1-IC3): AVD 200 V/mV, GBW 3 MHz, SR 13 V/us typ; supply pins +VS / -VS, output 1.5 V from each rail

1N4004.note: 1N4004 (drawing D1): same die as the 1N4001 (Diodes Inc. SPICE card IS=14.11n N=1.984 RS=33.89m), which differs only in PIV

J176.note: J176 P-channel switch JFET (drawing Q1). Approximate after the published vendor card (VTO about -2 V, BETA about 1.5 mA/V2, CGS 12.8 pF, CGD 13.9 pF); datasheet VGS(off) 1-4 V, rDS(on) <= 250 ohm. Here it only sits fully on (VGS = 0): about 170 ohm in series with R10 2.2K

controls.label: Gain
controls.note: VR1:B B100K: the wiper drives IC1:A's output, the MIN end is its feedback leg and the far end feeds IC1:B through C10, so one turn raises IC1:A (x1 -> x46) and lowers IC1:B's input resistance (109 k -> 9.4 k into 680 k)

controls.label: Volume
controls.note: VR1:A B100K across IC2:B's output and REF, wiper through R29 10K into R31 47K

controls.label: Bass
controls.note: VR3:A A100K rheostat in the tone stack's bass leg (C2 / C1 / R8)

controls.label: Treble
controls.note: VR3:B B20K between C3 and the bass network, wiper to IC2:A +. The drawing's MIN marker on VR3:B sits on the C3 end, which taken literally makes knob 0 the brightest setting (+4.4 dB at 8 kHz vs centre, knob 1 -8.4 dB). The other five pots' MIN markers all agree with the owner's manual, so the pot is inverted here (invert: true): 0 = least treble. Flagged in the notes

controls.label: Contour
controls.note: VR2:A B100K mixes the dry signal (C15) and IC3:A's output (R18) into IC3:B; IC3:A's + input is the Wien network driven by IC3:B

controls.label: Freq
controls.note: VR2:B/C dual C100K: both Wien-bridge resistances (15 nF series / 15 nF shunt) together

controls.label: Mode
controls.note: Overdrive / Distortion (owner's manual; forum reports: LEDs in Overdrive, 1N4148s in Distortion). SW2 A/B (2-pole, throws 2/6 L CLIP, 3/7 D CLIP; throws 4/5 and 8/9 unused). L CLIP: the two red LEDs only, C27 4n7 // R30 33K across R5 (IC2:A x1.7). D CLIP: the 1N4148 pair in parallel with the LEDs, R5 // C22 only (IC2:A x6.6). Raw 0 / 1

controls.label: Stereo
controls.note: Host stereo/mono routing flag; the pedal is mono. Stored only

controls.label: On/Off
controls.note: SW1 (A: OP from IP or EFFECT; B: MUTE or LED line to -VS) is the host's unit bypass. The netlist models the effect position: Q1 on, MUTE open, LED3 lit. Stored only

parts.label: 9 V battery snap / DC1 adaptor jack (CON12 pin 3 +9V, -VS = battery negative = signal ground)
Jack PCB C1 47pF/50V input shunt (between ferrite beads L1 and L5; the beads carry no value and are wires at audio)
VR1:B GAIN B100K (pin 4 MIN -> CON1.1 = IC1:A pin 2; wiper 5 -> CON1.2 = IC1:A out; pin 6 -> CON1.3 -> C10)
Q1 J176 gain-leg switch (drain C8/R34, source -VS, gate = the LED line held at -VS by SW1:B in the effect position: on)
LED3 red 3 mm effect indicator (control PCB, CON7 pin 1 +VS / pin 2)
R15 4.7K LED3 current limit to the LED line (SW1:B closes it to -VS in the effect position)
R14 4.7K (MUTE line from SW1:B joins here; open in the effect position)
IC1:B TL072 inverting gain stage, + at REF
LED1 red 3 mm clipper, anode at node B, cathode to the REF bus
LED2 red 3 mm clipper, anode at the REF bus, cathode at node B
SW2:A pole 1 (CON9.2 = node B) throw 3 D CLIP -> CON9.1 (throw 2 L CLIP open)
VR3:B TREBLE B20K (pin 4 MIN -> CON2.1/C3; wiper 5 -> CON2.2 -> IC2:A +; pin 6 -> CON2.3)
VR3:A BASS A100K rheostat: pin 3 + wiper 2 -> CON3.1 (CON2.3 / C2), pin 1 MIN -> CON3.2 (C1 / R8)
C6 68n/50V gain leg to the REF bus
SW2:B pole 10 (CON8.2) throw 6 L CLIP -> CON8.1 = node D (throw 7 D CLIP open)
IC3:A TL072, - from R9, + from the Wien network
VR2:A CONTOUR B100K (pin 1 MIN -> W1/CON4.1 = R18; wiper 2 -> W2/CON4.2 = IC3:B +; pin 3 -> W3/CON4.3 = C15/R9)
VR2:B FREQ C100K (gang with VR2:C) rheostat: pin 4 MIN + wiper 5 -> VR2:C pin 7 / wiper 8 -> CON5.2 (IC3:A +), pin 6 -> CON5.3 (R1): the Wien series arm
VR2:C FREQ C100K rheostat: pin 7 MIN + wiper 8 (joined where the wiper wire crosses the pin-7 bus, see the notes) -> CON5.2 = IC3:A + / C26; pin 9 -> CON5.1 = R3: the Wien shunt arm
R3 2.2K Wien shunt R to the REF bus
C24 2.2n/50V (across R22: see the notes on the drawing's wire crossings)
VR1:A VOLUME B100K (pin 3 -> CON6.1 = node F; wiper 2 -> CON6.2 -> R29; pin 1 MIN -> CON6.3 = REF)
C18 150n/63V output coupling -> CON11.3 EFFECT -> SW1:A -> OP jack
